notes.title: 0.3.1 - DRIVING UPDATE + LEADERBOARDS
notes.notes:
The desert map has been remastered! No more flat plains for the desert map.

With that, the vehicle mechanics have been also replaced, this new system features enhanced vehicle control, sound effects, visual effects, and more! Don't forget to share your feedback in the discussion board.

Steam integrations are being added, now save data is linked to your Steam account and you will no longer lose all progress by switching devices. 

With that, leader boards were added, now you can see who is the best across the 4 different markers (xp, drift, targets hit, and money scoreboards).

The UI has been nearly fully overhauled, no more grey buttons!

Share your thoughts on this update, and enjoy!
